_comment: Tiers as of the release named below. compatibility.json must match this exactly. Updated only by a release; a promotion on main that is not released will fail the guard, which is the point. OpenCode moved to T5 (encrypted sync) and Kimi to T2 (handoff source) three candidates ago, carried from the Hop client; this candidate changes no agent's tier, only fixing the Pi reader's real-session text extraction and widening the verified Qwen Code range to 0.23.0, both found by the prior candidate's tagged run (see CHANGELOG.md). Neither is a stable claim yet: stable stays v0.5.1 until a Windows tagged-artifact run promotes it (reinstate#369 tracks a clearer next-release marker for this gap).
